messages:
ana: FYI I'm raising a docs PR to reconcile the Supported Regions table and add a small SDK v2 migration note for endpoint overrides. Will also include a short residency caveat for EU customers. PR is draft.

tom: Nice. For the migration note do you want examples for env var, client param, and a short Ruby snippet? We mostly show JS/Python so adding Ruby could help customers on Rails.

ana: (I think you meant @ana) I like the Ruby idea — short one-liner. Keep all snippets <=7 lines.

ana: I'll include: ENV['REDWOOD_REGION_ENDPOINT'], direct client param, and a reminder to test routing in staging.

raja: Legal flagged that we must not imply full data residency for hosted plans. Suggested copy: "Hosted API requests may traverse regional control planes; for contractual data residency, Private deployment options are required." Add contact pointer to account teams.

ana: Thanks, @raja. Can you paste exact phrasing you'd prefer? I'll copy verbatim.

raja: Use: "For hosted deployments, request metadata and transient artifacts may be processed in region-specific control planes. Customers needing contractual data residency should contact their account representative or sales to discuss Private deployment"

ana: Copying into the draft.

nora: Micro UX note: the endpoints table header was renamed in a previous PR from 'Regions' to 'Supported regions' which broke two internal anchors. We should add a redirect snippet and update affected example pages.

ana: I'll add a short redirect note: "Legacy anchor #regions now points to #supported-regions." Also add CI link-check to ensure no broken anchors remain.

 tom: Snippet proposals below. Ruby tiny example for v2 client:
```rb
# Ruby
endpoint = ENV.fetch('REDWOOD_REGION_ENDPOINT', 'api.redwood-inference.com')
client = Redwood::Client.new(base_url: "https://#{endpoint}")
res = client.generate(model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'Summarize:')
```
And a one-line shell export example: `export REDWOOD_REGION_ENDPOINT=sg-api.redwood-inference.com`

ana: Couple of asks: 1) use canonical host `api.redwood-inference.com` as default, 2) add caption under examples: "Replace with your regional endpoint (see table)." 3) include an APAC example endpoint `sg-api.redwood-inference.com`.

 tom: Acknowledged. I'll switch the default host and add the caption. I verified `sg-api.redwood-inference.com` with infra.

nora: Preview build: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/4180/build789. Link-check failed on one old handbook link (needs update). I pushed a commit to fix the handbook link.

ana: Great. @raja please quick-check the residency sentence once more (legal sign-off).

raja: Looks good, just change "Private deployment" -> "a Private deployment" in the sentence. Otherwise approve.

ana: Updated.

docs-bot: docs build: link-check \u274c (handbook link fixed now), build \u2705, accessibility \u26a0\ufe0f (contrast flagged in table header).

nora: I'll open a follow-up PR to tweak the CSS contrast for the table header to meet AA. Not blocking merge.

ana: Plan: merge once CI passes and @tom does a final pass on snippets. I'll backport to the stable docs branch after merge.

 tom: Final pass done. LGTM.

ana: Merging now. Thanks all. Will post a short release note in #product once backport lands. :tada:
